Answer generation fallback is extractive and has no metric-to-column alignment step.
The UI renders a chunk excerpt as evidence, while the answer layer lacks structured financial values.
impact: A user may not know which number belongs to which quarter.
The answer is verbose and not directly actionable.
Numeric extraction cannot yet be safely used for calculations or comparison.
planned_fixes: Introduce table-aware row/column reconstruction in Document IR.
Represent extracted cells with row label, column label, value, unit and source bbox.
Add deterministic metric-period-value alignment before LLM generation.
Run arithmetic and column-count validation; abstain when alignment is ambiguous.
Render the final answer as a compact table and keep the raw excerpt collapsed.
